stage: Captain America again. Tony gives the shield back, and in the end Steve hands it to Sam Wilson

changes.evidence: The CW stage ('Gives up the name') runs to the end of the box, but in Avengers: Endgame (2023) Tony brings the repaired shield to the Avengers Compound and gives it back to Steve ('Why not? He made it for you'; Iron Man to Captain America: 'You lose this again, I'm keeping it'). Steve carries it through the Time Heist and the final battle, and as an old man passes the shield to Sam Wilson ('Like it's someone else's.' 'It isn't.'). So 'gives up the name' stops being true at Endgame, and a stage there is missing.
